scope.intent: rename the product to ZOS and consolidate production-owned data under /zos with mounted data under /zos/data

findings.title: Default Compose runtime ignored the configured apps root
findings.resolution: Pass config.paths.appsRoot, with the flattened compatibility field as fallback, and verify real materialization through the API.

findings.title: Host tooling allowed persistent backup and deployment paths outside the ZOS root
findings.resolution: Canonicalize and constrain installer, deployment, locale, and ACL backup overrides to their ZOS-owned directory trees.

findings.title: VOD refresh tooling accepted state paths outside the canonical state directory

appliedFixes: Propagated the configured apps root into the default Docker Compose runtime and added API-level materialization coverage.
Constrained installer, deployment, locale, and ACL persistent overrides to ZOS-owned roots.
Rejected filesystem-root ACL configurations and VOD session state outside its canonical directory.
Added focused regression tests and packaging assertions for the new boundaries.

testingGaps: A real Debian package and systemd services were not installed on the macOS review host.
Physical mount, ownership, backup, Docker, terminal, VOD, and appliance image acceptance require a target host.
residualRisks: The intentionally incompatible rename requires a fresh install or rebuilt image after backing up required data.
The ignored historical pre-ZOS directory remains on disk by design and is not part of the new runtime layout.

verification.applicationBrowser: passed headlessly at 1280x720 and 390x844 with no page errors, console errors, or document-level horizontal overflow
verification.legacyBrandAndPathScan: passed outside intentionally preserved ignored history
verification.debianPackage: not installed locally; target release gate
